parameters.label: Angle Effects

fields.label: Name
fields.description: Name used by the message text effect selector. Names are trimmed and case-insensitive. Avoid commas because selection splits on commas. Blank names and Untitled are ignored; normal clears the active effect. Duplicate normalized names merge their fields, with later entries overriding earlier ones; use distinct names for independent presets.
fields.context: Edit a named preset in this family. In Show Text, use \EFFECT<MyEffect>animated text<CLEAR EFFECTS>, with MyEffect replaced by your preset Name. Names are case-insensitive; blank and Untitled names are ignored. Text Effects must be enabled in game options. Effects apply to subsequent message glyphs/icons and reset at a new page; other windows do not animate this text. Numeric animation units use game update frames, normally about 60 per second. Selection splits preset names on commas and combines them in the specified order; later selected fields override earlier ones. During loading, duplicate normalized names merge in array order, then in family order Angle, Color, Opacity, Position, Scale; later fields win. Avoid commas in names and reserve normal for clearing the active effect.

entries.context: Edit a named preset in this family. In Show Text, use \EFFECT<MyEffect>animated text<CLEAR EFFECTS>, with MyEffect replaced by your preset Name. Names are case-insensitive; blank and Untitled names are ignored. Text Effects must be enabled in game options. Effects apply to subsequent message glyphs/icons and reset at a new page; other windows do not animate this text. Numeric animation units use game update frames, normally about 60 per second. Selection splits preset names on commas and combines them in the specified order; later selected fields override earlier ones. During loading, duplicate normalized names merge in array order, then in family order Angle, Color, Opacity, Position, Scale; later fields win. Avoid commas in names and reserve normal for clearing the active effect. Profile fields: PendulumArc: Pendulum angular amplitude in degrees. The glyph angle adds round(cos((frame + offset * glyphIndex) * speed) * arc). Zero disables pendulum motion; negative arc reverses the angular displacement. Use finite values; there is no additional amplitude clamp. PendulumSpeed: Pendulum cosine speed in radians per game frame. A nonzero speed has period 2*pi/abs(speed) frames; zero disables pendulum motion. Reversing its sign produces the same cosine. Use finite values. PendulumOffset: Pendulum phase offset in frames per glyph: phase = (Graphics.frameCount + offset * glyphIndex) * PendulumSpeed radians. Zero aligns glyphs; negative offsets move their phase in the opposite direction. glyphIndex starts at zero among the page animated glyphs/icons. No additional clamp. RotationSpeed: Continuous rotation in degrees per glyph update. Positive speed rotates counterclockwise and negative clockwise; zero disables continuous rotation. The speed is subtracted from the angle each frame and the angle wraps around 360 degrees. Use finite values. RotationOffset: Initial continuous-rotation angle in degrees per glyph: starting angle = offset * glyphIndex. Index starts at zero among the page animated glyphs/icons. Applied only when RotationSpeed is nonzero, before its first update. Positive angles turn clockwise; finite negative values are allowed and angles wrap around 360 degrees.
entries.expected: Preset Swing composes the configured PendulumArc, PendulumSpeed, PendulumOffset, RotationSpeed, RotationOffset fields of AngleEffects. Matching names in other families compose the same effect; later fields override earlier ones.
entries.availabilityReason: Ative o plugin indicado e suas dependências no jogo. Disponibilidade descreve a capacidade, não verifica a configuração do projeto.

entries.title: AngleEffects/RollCW
entries.context: Edit a named preset in this family. In Show Text, use \EFFECT<MyEffect>animated text<CLEAR EFFECTS>, with MyEffect replaced by your preset Name. Names are case-insensitive; blank and Untitled names are ignored. Text Effects must be enabled in game options. Effects apply to subsequent message glyphs/icons and reset at a new page; other windows do not animate this text. Numeric animation units use game update frames, normally about 60 per second. Selection splits preset names on commas and combines them in the specified order; later selected fields override earlier ones. During loading, duplicate normalized names merge in array order, then in family order Angle, Color, Opacity, Position, Scale; later fields win. Avoid commas in names and reserve normal for clearing the active effect. Profile fields: PendulumArc: Pendulum angular amplitude in degrees. The glyph angle adds round(cos((frame + offset * glyphIndex) * speed) * arc). Zero disables pendulum motion; negative arc reverses the angular displacement. Use finite values; there is no additional amplitude clamp. PendulumSpeed: Pendulum cosine speed in radians per game frame. A nonzero speed has period 2*pi/abs(speed) frames; zero disables pendulum motion. Reversing its sign produces the same cosine. Use finite values. PendulumOffset: Pendulum phase offset in frames per glyph: phase = (Graphics.frameCount + offset * glyphIndex) * PendulumSpeed radians. Zero aligns glyphs; negative offsets move their phase in the opposite direction. glyphIndex starts at zero among the page animated glyphs/icons. No additional clamp. RotationSpeed: Continuous rotation in degrees per glyph update. Positive speed rotates counterclockwise and negative clockwise; zero disables continuous rotation. The speed is subtracted from the angle each frame and the angle wraps around 360 degrees. Use finite values. RotationOffset: Initial continuous-rotation angle in degrees per glyph: starting angle = offset * glyphIndex. Index starts at zero among the page animated glyphs/icons. Applied only when RotationSpeed is nonzero, before its first update. Positive angles turn clockwise; finite negative values are allowed and angles wrap around 360 degrees.
entries.expected: Preset RollCW composes the configured PendulumArc, PendulumSpeed, PendulumOffset, RotationSpeed, RotationOffset fields of AngleEffects. Matching names in other families compose the same effect; later fields override earlier ones.

entries.title: ColorEffects/Prism
entries.context: Edit a named preset in this family. In Show Text, use \EFFECT<MyEffect>animated text<CLEAR EFFECTS>, with MyEffect replaced by your preset Name. Names are case-insensitive; blank and Untitled names are ignored. Text Effects must be enabled in game options. Effects apply to subsequent message glyphs/icons and reset at a new page; other windows do not animate this text. Numeric animation units use game update frames, normally about 60 per second. Selection splits preset names on commas and combines them in the specified order; later selected fields override earlier ones. During loading, duplicate normalized names merge in array order, then in family order Angle, Color, Opacity, Position, Scale; later fields win. Avoid commas in names and reserve normal for clearing the active effect. Profile fields: ForcedColor: Forced glyph text color: use a string containing an MZ text-color palette number, such as "2", or a CSS color such as "#ff0000". An empty string keeps the normal message color. HueShift: Hue increment in degrees per glyph update. A full color cycle is 360 degrees; positive and negative values traverse it in opposite directions. Zero disables hue animation and InitialHueOffset. Use finite values; the runtime wraps the hue while rendering the cyclic color. InitialHueOffset: Initial hue angle in degrees per glyph: initial hue = offset * glyphIndex, then HueShift is added on the first update. Index starts at zero among the page animated glyphs/icons. Positive/negative finite offsets shift the cyclic colors in opposite directions; only used when HueShift is nonzero. colorTones: Ordered tone sequence. Supply a JSON array of JavaScript source strings, each evaluating to [red, green, blue, gray], for example ["[40, 0, 0, 0]", "[0, 0, 40, 0]"]. Use RGB offsets -255..255 (0 neutral; positive adds, negative subtracts) and gray 0..255 (0 original saturation, 255 grayscale). An empty list disables tone animation. Values are evaluated at configuration loading; use four finite numeric components per tone. toneDelay: Delay in game update frames between tone changes. The effective delay is max(value, 1), so the published default 0 advances every frame. Use whole frame counts; an empty tone sequence ignores this field. InitialToneOffset: Initial tone-sequence offset in whole tone entries per glyph. Initial index is (offset * glyphIndex + floor(Graphics.frameCount / max(toneDelay, 1))) wrapped to the sequence length; negative offsets wrap too. Zero starts glyphs together. Use whole numbers to avoid a missing array entry; an empty tone sequence ignores this field. SmoothToneChange: Make a smooth transition for tone changes?
entries.expected: Preset Prism composes the configured ForcedColor, HueShift, InitialHueOffset, colorTones, toneDelay, InitialToneOffset, SmoothToneChange fields of ColorEffects. Matching names in other families compose the same effect; later fields override earlier ones.

entries.title: ColorEffects/FastGamer
entries.context: Edit a named preset in this family. In Show Text, use \EFFECT<MyEffect>animated text<CLEAR EFFECTS>, with MyEffect replaced by your preset Name. Names are case-insensitive; blank and Untitled names are ignored. Text Effects must be enabled in game options. Effects apply to subsequent message glyphs/icons and reset at a new page; other windows do not animate this text. Numeric animation units use game update frames, normally about 60 per second. Selection splits preset names on commas and combines them in the specified order; later selected fields override earlier ones. During loading, duplicate normalized names merge in array order, then in family order Angle, Color, Opacity, Position, Scale; later fields win. Avoid commas in names and reserve normal for clearing the active effect. Profile fields: ForcedColor: Forced glyph text color: use a string containing an MZ text-color palette number, such as "2", or a CSS color such as "#ff0000". An empty string keeps the normal message color. HueShift: Hue increment in degrees per glyph update. A full color cycle is 360 degrees; positive and negative values traverse it in opposite directions. Zero disables hue animation and InitialHueOffset. Use finite values; the runtime wraps the hue while rendering the cyclic color. InitialHueOffset: Initial hue angle in degrees per glyph: initial hue = offset * glyphIndex, then HueShift is added on the first update. Index starts at zero among the page animated glyphs/icons. Positive/negative finite offsets shift the cyclic colors in opposite directions; only used when HueShift is nonzero. colorTones: Ordered tone sequence. Supply a JSON array of JavaScript source strings, each evaluating to [red, green, blue, gray], for example ["[40, 0, 0, 0]", "[0, 0, 40, 0]"]. Use RGB offsets -255..255 (0 neutral; positive adds, negative subtracts) and gray 0..255 (0 original saturation, 255 grayscale). An empty list disables tone animation. Values are evaluated at configuration loading; use four finite numeric components per tone. toneDelay: Delay in game update frames between tone changes. The effective delay is max(value, 1), so the published default 0 advances every frame. Use whole frame counts; an empty tone sequence ignores this field. InitialToneOffset: Initial tone-sequence offset in whole tone entries per glyph. Initial index is (offset * glyphIndex + floor(Graphics.frameCount / max(toneDelay, 1))) wrapped to the sequence length; negative offsets wrap too. Zero starts glyphs together. Use whole numbers to avoid a missing array entry; an empty tone sequence ignores this field. SmoothToneChange: Make a smooth transition for tone changes?
entries.expected: Preset FastGamer composes the configured ForcedColor, HueShift, InitialHueOffset, colorTones, toneDelay, InitialToneOffset, SmoothToneChange fields of ColorEffects. Matching names in other families compose the same effect; later fields override earlier ones.

entries.title: ColorEffects/Cyan
entries.context: Edit a named preset in this family. In Show Text, use \EFFECT<MyEffect>animated text<CLEAR EFFECTS>, with MyEffect replaced by your preset Name. Names are case-insensitive; blank and Untitled names are ignored. Text Effects must be enabled in game options. Effects apply to subsequent message glyphs/icons and reset at a new page; other windows do not animate this text. Numeric animation units use game update frames, normally about 60 per second. Selection splits preset names on commas and combines them in the specified order; later selected fields override earlier ones. During loading, duplicate normalized names merge in array order, then in family order Angle, Color, Opacity, Position, Scale; later fields win. Avoid commas in names and reserve normal for clearing the active effect. Profile fields: ForcedColor: Forced glyph text color: use a string containing an MZ text-color palette number, such as "2", or a CSS color such as "#ff0000". An empty string keeps the normal message color. HueShift: Hue increment in degrees per glyph update. A full color cycle is 360 degrees; positive and negative values traverse it in opposite directions. Zero disables hue animation and InitialHueOffset. Use finite values; the runtime wraps the hue while rendering the cyclic color. InitialHueOffset: Initial hue angle in degrees per glyph: initial hue = offset * glyphIndex, then HueShift is added on the first update. Index starts at zero among the page animated glyphs/icons. Positive/negative finite offsets shift the cyclic colors in opposite directions; only used when HueShift is nonzero. colorTones: Ordered tone sequence. Supply a JSON array of JavaScript source strings, each evaluating to [red, green, blue, gray], for example ["[40, 0, 0, 0]", "[0, 0, 40, 0]"]. Use RGB offsets -255..255 (0 neutral; positive adds, negative subtracts) and gray 0..255 (0 original saturation, 255 grayscale). An empty list disables tone animation. Values are evaluated at configuration loading; use four finite numeric components per tone. toneDelay: Delay in game update frames between tone changes. The effective delay is max(value, 1), so the published default 0 advances every frame. Use whole frame counts; an empty tone sequence ignores this field. InitialToneOffset: Initial tone-sequence offset in whole tone entries per glyph. Initial index is (offset * glyphIndex + floor(Graphics.frameCount / max(toneDelay, 1))) wrapped to the sequence length; negative offsets wrap too. Zero starts glyphs together. Use whole numbers to avoid a missing array entry; an empty tone sequence ignores this field. SmoothToneChange: Make a smooth transition for tone changes?

entries.title: ColorEffects/SlowGig
entries.context: Edit a named preset in this family. In Show Text, use \EFFECT<MyEffect>animated text<CLEAR EFFECTS>, with MyEffect replaced by your preset Name. Names are case-insensitive; blank and Untitled names are ignored. Text Effects must be enabled in game options. Effects apply to subsequent message glyphs/icons and reset at a new page; other windows do not animate this text. Numeric animation units use game update frames, normally about 60 per second. Selection splits preset names on commas and combines them in the specified order; later selected fields override earlier ones. During loading, duplicate normalized names merge in array order, then in family order Angle, Color, Opacity, Position, Scale; later fields win. Avoid commas in names and reserve normal for clearing the active effect. Profile fields: ForcedColor: Forced glyph text color: use a string containing an MZ text-color palette number, such as "2", or a CSS color such as "#ff0000". An empty string keeps the normal message color. HueShift: Hue increment in degrees per glyph update. A full color cycle is 360 degrees; positive and negative values traverse it in opposite directions. Zero disables hue animation and InitialHueOffset. Use finite values; the runtime wraps the hue while rendering the cyclic color. InitialHueOffset: Initial hue angle in degrees per glyph: initial hue = offset * glyphIndex, then HueShift is added on the first update. Index starts at zero among the page animated glyphs/icons. Positive/negative finite offsets shift the cyclic colors in opposite directions; only used when HueShift is nonzero. colorTones: Ordered tone sequence. Supply a JSON array of JavaScript source strings, each evaluating to [red, green, blue, gray], for example ["[40, 0, 0, 0]", "[0, 0, 40, 0]"]. Use RGB offsets -255..255 (0 neutral; positive adds, negative subtracts) and gray 0..255 (0 original saturation, 255 grayscale). An empty list disables tone animation. Values are evaluated at configuration loading; use four finite numeric components per tone. toneDelay: Delay in game update frames between tone changes. The effective delay is max(value, 1), so the published default 0 advances every frame. Use whole frame counts; an empty tone sequence ignores this field. InitialToneOffset: Initial tone-sequence offset in whole tone entries per glyph. Initial index is (offset * glyphIndex + floor(Graphics.frameCount / max(toneDelay, 1))) wrapped to the sequence length; negative offsets wrap too. Zero starts glyphs together. Use whole numbers to avoid a missing array entry; an empty tone sequence ignores this field. SmoothToneChange: Make a smooth transition for tone changes?

entries.title: OpacityEffects/Glow
entries.context: Edit a named preset in this family. In Show Text, use \EFFECT<MyEffect>animated text<CLEAR EFFECTS>, with MyEffect replaced by your preset Name. Names are case-insensitive; blank and Untitled names are ignored. Text Effects must be enabled in game options. Effects apply to subsequent message glyphs/icons and reset at a new page; other windows do not animate this text. Numeric animation units use game update frames, normally about 60 per second. Selection splits preset names on commas and combines them in the specified order; later selected fields override earlier ones. During loading, duplicate normalized names merge in array order, then in family order Angle, Color, Opacity, Position, Scale; later fields win. Avoid commas in names and reserve normal for clearing the active effect. Profile fields: InitialOpacity: Base glyph opacity from 0 (invisible) to 255 (opaque). Pattern letters multiply this value and glow then adjusts it; the rendered result is clamped to 0..255. Use a finite value in that range. glowRate: Glow depth as a factor of 255 opacity units. The adjustment is round((cos(phase) - 1) * glowRate * 255 / 2), added after the pattern. For a fading glow, use 0..1; 0 disables glow, 1 can subtract up to 255. Negative factors brighten instead; rendered opacity is clamped to 0..255. No additional factor clamp. glowSpeed: Glow cosine speed in radians per game frame. Period is 2*pi/abs(speed) frames when nonzero; zero disables glow. A negative speed gives the same cosine as its positive counterpart. Use finite values. glowOffset: Glow phase offset in frames per glyph: phase = (Graphics.frameCount + offset * glyphIndex) * glowSpeed radians. Index starts at zero among the page animated glyphs/icons. Zero synchronizes glyphs; finite negative offsets reverse their phase spacing. pattern: Repeating opacity pattern of letters a..z, case-insensitive with surrounding whitespace trimmed. a multiplies base opacity by 0, z by 1, and intermediate letters by (letterCode - 97)/25. The pattern advances every max(patternDelay, 1) frames and wraps. Empty text disables the pattern and leaves base opacity for glow processing. patternDelay: Delay in game update frames between opacity-pattern steps. The effective delay is max(value, 1), so the published default 0 advances every frame. Use whole frame counts; an empty pattern ignores this field. patternOffset: Initial pattern position in characters per glyph: index = patternOffset * glyphIndex, wrapped to the pattern length, including negative values. Use whole numbers; character lookup truncates any fractional index. Each update step advances one character and wraps. Zero synchronizes glyphs; an empty pattern ignores this field.
entries.expected: Preset Glow composes the configured InitialOpacity, glowRate, glowSpeed, glowOffset, pattern, patternDelay, patternOffset fields of OpacityEffects. Matching names in other families compose the same effect; later fields override earlier ones.

Effects apply to subsequent message glyphs/icons and reset at a new page; other windows do not animate this text. Numeric animation units use game update frames, normally about 60 per second. Selection splits preset names on commas and combines them in the specified order; later selected fields override earlier ones. During loading, duplicate normalized names merge in array order, then in family order Angle, Color, Opacity, Position, Scale; later fields win. Avoid commas in names and reserve normal for clearing the active effect. Profile fields: InitialOpacity: Base glyph opacity from 0 (invisible) to 255 (opaque). Pattern letters multiply this value and glow then adjusts it; the rendered result is clamped to 0..255. Use a finite value in that range. glowRate: Glow depth as a factor of 255 opacity units. The adjustment is round((cos(phase) - 1) * glowRate * 255 / 2), added after the pattern. For a fading glow, use 0..1; 0 disables glow, 1 can subtract up to 255. Negative factors brighten instead; rendered opacity is clamped to 0..255. No additional factor clamp. glowSpeed: Glow cosine speed in radians per game frame. Period is 2*pi/abs(speed) frames when nonzero; zero disables glow. A negative speed gives the same cosine as its positive counterpart. Use finite values. glowOffset: Glow phase offset in frames per glyph: phase = (Graphics.frameCount + offset * glyphIndex) * glowSpeed radians. Index starts at zero among the page animated glyphs/icons. Zero synchronizes glyphs; finite negative offsets reverse their phase spacing. pattern: Repeating opacity pattern of letters a..z, case-insensitive with surrounding whitespace trimmed. a multiplies base opacity by 0, z by 1, and intermediate letters by (letterCode - 97)/25. The pattern advances every max(patternDelay, 1) frames and wraps. Empty text disables the pattern and leaves base opacity for glow processing. patternDelay: Delay in game update frames between opacity-pattern steps. The effective delay is max(value, 1), so the published default 0 advances every frame. Use whole frame counts; an empty pattern ignores this field. patternOffset: Initial pattern position in characters per glyph: index = patternOffset * glyphIndex, wrapped to the pattern length, including negative values. Use whole numbers; character lookup truncates any fractional index. Each update step advances one character and wraps. Zero synchronizes glyphs; an empty pattern ignores this field.
entries.expected: Preset Fade composes the configured InitialOpacity, glowRate, glowSpeed, glowOffset, pattern, patternDelay, patternOffset fields of OpacityEffects. Matching names in other families compose the same effect; later fields override earlier ones.
entries.availabilityReason: Ative o plugin indicado e suas dependências no jogo. Disponibilidade descreve a capacidade, não verifica a configuração do projeto.

entries.writing: Enable Coreto_0_CoreEngine 0.1.0, Coreto_1_MessageCore 0.1.0 and Coreto_2_AniMsgTextEffects 0.1.0 in that order. Run ani-message effects list --family OpacityEffects --json to locate Name=Fade in the effective configuration. Its returned index is zero-based and can differ after edits. Update only the desired keys with ani-message effects update --family OpacityEffects --index INDEX --value JSON --expected-hash HASH_FROM_LIST --json, replacing HASH_FROM_LIST with result.fileHash from that fresh effects list/get response. A missing or stale hash rejects the mutation. Omitted keys remain unchanged. Run the CLI with --project pointing to the game. Reload the editor after writes and restart the game to load changed presets. The first functional write from inherit materializes own configuration.

entries.title: PositionEffects/Shake
entries.context: Edit a named preset in this family. In Show Text, use \EFFECT<MyEffect>animated text<CLEAR EFFECTS>, with MyEffect replaced by your preset Name. Names are case-insensitive; blank and Untitled names are ignored. Text Effects must be enabled in game options. Effects apply to subsequent message glyphs/icons and reset at a new page; other windows do not animate this text. Numeric animation units use game update frames, normally about 60 per second. Selection splits preset names on commas and combines them in the specified order; later selected fields override earlier ones. During loading, duplicate normalized names merge in array order, then in family order Angle, Color, Opacity, Position, Scale; later fields win. Avoid commas in names and reserve normal for clearing the active effect. Profile fields: ShakeStrengthHorz: Horizontal random shake amplitude in pixels. Use a nonnegative whole number N: each frame adds a randomly signed integer from 0 through N to the glyph base X. Zero disables horizontal shake. Fractional and negative inputs are not clamped and do not produce this documented amplitude distribution. ShakeStrengthVert: Vertical random shake amplitude in pixels. Use a nonnegative whole number N: each frame adds a randomly signed integer from 0 through N to the glyph base Y. Zero disables vertical shake. Fractional and negative inputs are not clamped and do not produce this documented amplitude distribution. WaveDistanceX: Horizontal wave amplitude in pixels. Adds round(cos(phase) * distance) to the glyph base X; it oscillates between approximately -abs(distance) and +abs(distance). Zero disables this axis and negative distance reverses displacement. Use finite values; no additional clamp. WaveSpeedX: Horizontal wave cosine speed in radians per game frame. A nonzero speed has period 2*pi/abs(speed) frames; zero disables the wave. Changing the sign yields the same cosine. Use finite values. WaveOffsetX: Horizontal wave phase offset in frames per glyph: phase = (Graphics.frameCount + offset * glyphIndex) * WaveSpeedX radians. Index starts at zero among the page animated glyphs/icons. Zero aligns glyphs; negative finite offsets reverse their phase spacing. WaveDistanceY: Vertical wave amplitude in pixels. Adds round(cos(phase) * distance) to the glyph base Y; it oscillates between approximately -abs(distance) and +abs(distance). Zero disables this axis and negative distance reverses displacement. Use finite values; no additional clamp. WaveSpeedY: Vertical wave cosine speed in radians per game frame. A nonzero speed has period 2*pi/abs(speed) frames; zero disables the wave. Changing the sign yields the same cosine. Use finite values. WaveOffsetY: Vertical wave phase offset in frames per glyph: phase = (Graphics.frameCount + offset * glyphIndex) * WaveSpeedY radians. Index starts at zero among the page animated glyphs/icons. Zero aligns glyphs; negative finite offsets reverse their phase spacing.
entries.expected: Preset Shake composes the configured ShakeStrengthHorz, ShakeStrengthVert, WaveDistanceX, WaveSpeedX, WaveOffsetX, WaveDistanceY, WaveSpeedY, WaveOffsetY fields of PositionEffects. Matching names in other families compose the same effect; later fields override earlier ones.

entries.title: PositionEffects/Vibe
entries.context: Edit a named preset in this family. In Show Text, use \EFFECT<MyEffect>animated text<CLEAR EFFECTS>, with MyEffect replaced by your preset Name. Names are case-insensitive; blank and Untitled names are ignored. Text Effects must be enabled in game options. Effects apply to subsequent message glyphs/icons and reset at a new page; other windows do not animate this text. Numeric animation units use game update frames, normally about 60 per second. Selection splits preset names on commas and combines them in the specified order; later selected fields override earlier ones. During loading, duplicate normalized names merge in array order, then in family order Angle, Color, Opacity, Position, Scale; later fields win. Avoid commas in names and reserve normal for clearing the active effect. Profile fields: ShakeStrengthHorz: Horizontal random shake amplitude in pixels. Use a nonnegative whole number N: each frame adds a randomly signed integer from 0 through N to the glyph base X. Zero disables horizontal shake. Fractional and negative inputs are not clamped and do not produce this documented amplitude distribution. ShakeStrengthVert: Vertical random shake amplitude in pixels. Use a nonnegative whole number N: each frame adds a randomly signed integer from 0 through N to the glyph base Y. Zero disables vertical shake. Fractional and negative inputs are not clamped and do not produce this documented amplitude distribution. WaveDistanceX: Horizontal wave amplitude in pixels. Adds round(cos(phase) * distance) to the glyph base X; it oscillates between approximately -abs(distance) and +abs(distance). Zero disables this axis and negative distance reverses displacement. Use finite values; no additional clamp. WaveSpeedX: Horizontal wave cosine speed in radians per game frame. A nonzero speed has period 2*pi/abs(speed) frames; zero disables the wave. Changing the sign yields the same cosine. Use finite values. WaveOffsetX: Horizontal wave phase offset in frames per glyph: phase = (Graphics.frameCount + offset * glyphIndex) * WaveSpeedX radians. Index starts at zero among the page animated glyphs/icons. Zero aligns glyphs; negative finite offsets reverse their phase spacing. WaveDistanceY: Vertical wave amplitude in pixels. Adds round(cos(phase) * distance) to the glyph base Y; it oscillates between approximately -abs(distance) and +abs(distance). Zero disables this axis and negative distance reverses displacement. Use finite values; no additional clamp. WaveSpeedY: Vertical wave cosine speed in radians per game frame. A nonzero speed has period 2*pi/abs(speed) frames; zero disables the wave. Changing the sign yields the same cosine. Use finite values. WaveOffsetY: Vertical wave phase offset in frames per glyph: phase = (Graphics.frameCount + offset * glyphIndex) * WaveSpeedY radians. Index starts at zero among the page animated glyphs/icons. Zero aligns glyphs; negative finite offsets reverse their phase spacing.
entries.expected: Preset Vibe composes the configured ShakeStrengthHorz, ShakeStrengthVert, WaveDistanceX, WaveSpeedX, WaveOffsetX, WaveDistanceY, WaveSpeedY, WaveOffsetY fields of PositionEffects. Matching names in other families compose the same effect; later fields override earlier ones.

entries.title: PositionEffects/SlowVertWave
entries.context: Edit a named preset in this family. In Show Text, use \EFFECT<MyEffect>animated text<CLEAR EFFECTS>, with MyEffect replaced by your preset Name. Names are case-insensitive; blank and Untitled names are ignored. Text Effects must be enabled in game options. Effects apply to subsequent message glyphs/icons and reset at a new page; other windows do not animate this text. Numeric animation units use game update frames, normally about 60 per second. Selection splits preset names on commas and combines them in the specified order; later selected fields override earlier ones. During loading, duplicate normalized names merge in array order, then in family order Angle, Color, Opacity, Position, Scale; later fields win. Avoid commas in names and reserve normal for clearing the active effect. Profile fields: ShakeStrengthHorz: Horizontal random shake amplitude in pixels. Use a nonnegative whole number N: each frame adds a randomly signed integer from 0 through N to the glyph base X. Zero disables horizontal shake. Fractional and negative inputs are not clamped and do not produce this documented amplitude distribution. ShakeStrengthVert: Vertical random shake amplitude in pixels. Use a nonnegative whole number N: each frame adds a randomly signed integer from 0 through N to the glyph base Y. Zero disables vertical shake. Fractional and negative inputs are not clamped and do not produce this documented amplitude distribution. WaveDistanceX: Horizontal wave amplitude in pixels. Adds round(cos(phase) * distance) to the glyph base X; it oscillates between approximately -abs(distance) and +abs(distance). Zero disables this axis and negative distance reverses displacement. Use finite values; no additional clamp. WaveSpeedX: Horizontal wave cosine speed in radians per game frame. A nonzero speed has period 2*pi/abs(speed) frames; zero disables the wave. Changing the sign yields the same cosine. Use finite values. WaveOffsetX: Horizontal wave phase offset in frames per glyph: phase = (Graphics.frameCount + offset * glyphIndex) * WaveSpeedX radians. Index starts at zero among the page animated glyphs/icons. Zero aligns glyphs; negative finite offsets reverse their phase spacing. WaveDistanceY: Vertical wave amplitude in pixels. Adds round(cos(phase) * distance) to the glyph base Y; it oscillates between approximately -abs(distance) and +abs(distance). Zero disables this axis and negative distance reverses displacement. Use finite values; no additional clamp. WaveSpeedY: Vertical wave cosine speed in radians per game frame. A nonzero speed has period 2*pi/abs(speed) frames; zero disables the wave. Changing the sign yields the same cosine. Use finite values. WaveOffsetY: Vertical wave phase offset in frames per glyph: phase = (Graphics.frameCount + offset * glyphIndex) * WaveSpeedY radians. Index starts at zero among the page animated glyphs/icons. Zero aligns glyphs; negative finite offsets reverse their phase spacing.

FlipOffsetY: Y-axis flip phase offset in frames per glyph. phase = (Graphics.frameCount + offset * glyphIndex) * FlipSpeedY. Zero aligns glyphs; finite negative offsets reverse phase spacing. Index starts at zero among animated glyphs/icons. PulseGrowthX: X-axis pulse growth factor: multiplier = 1 + cos(phase) * growth/2, applied with the flip and message-window scale. Zero disables pulsing. For growth 1, scale ranges from 0.5 to 1.5 times the base; negative growth reverses the pulse. Values with abs(growth)>2 can mirror the glyph. Use finite values; no additional clamp. PulseSpeedX: X-axis pulse cosine speed in radians per game frame. Period = 2*pi/abs(speed) frames for nonzero values; zero disables pulsing. Changing the sign yields the same cosine. Use finite values. PulseOffsetX: X-axis pulse phase offset in frames per glyph. phase = (Graphics.frameCount + offset * glyphIndex) * PulseSpeedX. PulseGrowthY: Y-axis pulse growth factor: multiplier = 1 + cos(phase) * growth/2, applied with the flip and message-window scale. Zero disables pulsing. For growth 1, scale ranges from 0.5 to 1.5 times the base; negative growth reverses the pulse. Values with abs(growth)>2 can mirror the glyph. Use finite values; no additional clamp. PulseSpeedY: Y-axis pulse cosine speed in radians per game frame. Period = 2*pi/abs(speed) frames for nonzero values; zero disables pulsing. Changing the sign yields the same cosine. Use finite values. PulseOffsetY: Y-axis pulse phase offset in frames per glyph. phase = (Graphics.frameCount + offset * glyphIndex) * PulseSpeedY. Zero aligns glyphs; finite negative offsets reverse phase spacing. Index starts at zero among animated glyphs/icons.

entries.title: ScaleEffects/BigPulse
entries.context: Edit a named preset in this family. In Show Text, use \EFFECT<MyEffect>animated text<CLEAR EFFECTS>, with MyEffect replaced by your preset Name. Names are case-insensitive; blank and Untitled names are ignored. Text Effects must be enabled in game options. Effects apply to subsequent message glyphs/icons and reset at a new page; other windows do not animate this text. Numeric animation units use game update frames, normally about 60 per second. Selection splits preset names on commas and combines them in the specified order; later selected fields override earlier ones. During loading, duplicate normalized names merge in array order, then in family order Angle, Color, Opacity, Position, Scale; later fields win. Avoid commas in names and reserve normal for clearing the active effect. Profile fields: FlipSpeedX: X-axis flip cosine speed in radians per game frame; multiplier = cos((frame + FlipOffsetX * glyphIndex) * speed). It cycles from normal scale through zero to mirrored scale with period 2*pi/abs(speed). Zero disables the flip; changing speed sign yields the same cosine. Use finite values. FlipOffsetX: X-axis flip phase offset in frames per glyph. phase = (Graphics.frameCount + offset * glyphIndex) * FlipSpeedX. Zero aligns glyphs; finite negative offsets reverse phase spacing. Index starts at zero among animated glyphs/icons. FlipSpeedY: Y-axis flip cosine speed in radians per game frame; multiplier = cos((frame + FlipOffsetY * glyphIndex) * speed). It cycles from normal scale through zero to mirrored scale with period 2*pi/abs(speed). Zero disables the flip; changing speed sign yields the same cosine. Use finite values. FlipOffsetY: Y-axis flip phase offset in frames per glyph. phase = (Graphics.frameCount + offset * glyphIndex) * FlipSpeedY. Zero aligns glyphs; finite negative offsets reverse phase spacing. Index starts at zero among animated glyphs/icons. PulseGrowthX: X-axis pulse growth factor: multiplier = 1 + cos(phase) * growth/2, applied with the flip and message-window scale. Zero disables pulsing. For growth 1, scale ranges from 0.5 to 1.5 times the base; negative growth reverses the pulse. Values with abs(growth)>2 can mirror the glyph. Use finite values; no additional clamp. PulseSpeedX: X-axis pulse cosine speed in radians per game frame. Period = 2*pi/abs(speed) frames for nonzero values; zero disables pulsing. Changing the sign yields the same cosine. Use finite values. PulseOffsetX: X-axis pulse phase offset in frames per glyph. phase = (Graphics.frameCount + offset * glyphIndex) * PulseSpeedX. Zero aligns glyphs; finite negative offsets reverse phase spacing. Index starts at zero among animated glyphs/icons. PulseGrowthY: Y-axis pulse growth factor: multiplier = 1 + cos(phase) * growth/2, applied with the flip and message-window scale. Zero disables pulsing. For growth 1, scale ranges from 0.5 to 1.5 times the base; negative growth reverses the pulse. Values with abs(growth)>2 can mirror the glyph. Use finite values; no additional clamp. PulseSpeedY: Y-axis pulse cosine speed in radians per game frame. Period = 2*pi/abs(speed) frames for nonzero values; zero disables pulsing. Changing the sign yields the same cosine. Use finite values. PulseOffsetY: Y-axis pulse phase offset in frames per glyph. phase = (Graphics.frameCount + offset * glyphIndex) * PulseSpeedY. Zero aligns glyphs; finite negative offsets reverse phase spacing. Index starts at zero among animated glyphs/icons.

entries.title: ScaleEffects/SmallGooey
entries.context: Edit a named preset in this family. In Show Text, use \EFFECT<MyEffect>animated text<CLEAR EFFECTS>, with MyEffect replaced by your preset Name. Names are case-insensitive; blank and Untitled names are ignored. Text Effects must be enabled in game options. Effects apply to subsequent message glyphs/icons and reset at a new page; other windows do not animate this text. Numeric animation units use game update frames, normally about 60 per second. Selection splits preset names on commas and combines them in the specified order; later selected fields override earlier ones. During loading, duplicate normalized names merge in array order, then in family order Angle, Color, Opacity, Position, Scale; later fields win. Avoid commas in names and reserve normal for clearing the active effect. Profile fields: FlipSpeedX: X-axis flip cosine speed in radians per game frame; multiplier = cos((frame + FlipOffsetX * glyphIndex) * speed). It cycles from normal scale through zero to mirrored scale with period 2*pi/abs(speed). Zero disables the flip; changing speed sign yields the same cosine. Use finite values. FlipOffsetX: X-axis flip phase offset in frames per glyph. phase = (Graphics.frameCount + offset * glyphIndex) * FlipSpeedX. Zero aligns glyphs; finite negative offsets reverse phase spacing. Index starts at zero among animated glyphs/icons. FlipSpeedY: Y-axis flip cosine speed in radians per game frame; multiplier = cos((frame + FlipOffsetY * glyphIndex) * speed). It cycles from normal scale through zero to mirrored scale with period 2*pi/abs(speed). Zero disables the flip; changing speed sign yields the same cosine. Use finite values. FlipOffsetY: Y-axis flip phase offset in frames per glyph. phase = (Graphics.frameCount + offset * glyphIndex) * FlipSpeedY. Zero aligns glyphs; finite negative offsets reverse phase spacing. Index starts at zero among animated glyphs/icons. PulseGrowthX: X-axis pulse growth factor: multiplier = 1 + cos(phase) * growth/2, applied with the flip and message-window scale. Zero disables pulsing. For growth 1, scale ranges from 0.5 to 1.5 times the base; negative growth reverses the pulse. Values with abs(growth)>2 can mirror the glyph. Use finite values; no additional clamp. PulseSpeedX: X-axis pulse cosine speed in radians per game frame. Period = 2*pi/abs(speed) frames for nonzero values; zero disables pulsing. Changing the sign yields the same cosine. Use finite values. PulseOffsetX: X-axis pulse phase offset in frames per glyph. phase = (Graphics.frameCount + offset * glyphIndex) * PulseSpeedX. Zero aligns glyphs; finite negative offsets reverse phase spacing. Index starts at zero among animated glyphs/icons. PulseGrowthY: Y-axis pulse growth factor: multiplier = 1 + cos(phase) * growth/2, applied with the flip and message-window scale. Zero disables pulsing. For growth 1, scale ranges from 0.5 to 1.5 times the base; negative growth reverses the pulse. Values with abs(growth)>2 can mirror the glyph. Use finite values; no additional clamp. PulseSpeedY: Y-axis pulse cosine speed in radians per game frame. Period = 2*pi/abs(speed) frames for nonzero values; zero disables pulsing. Changing the sign yields the same cosine. Use finite values. PulseOffsetY: Y-axis pulse phase offset in frames per glyph. phase = (Graphics.frameCount + offset * glyphIndex) * PulseSpeedY. Zero aligns glyphs; finite negative offsets reverse phase spacing. Index starts at zero among animated glyphs/icons.

entries.title: glyph-lifecycle
entries.context: Enable Coreto_0_CoreEngine, Coreto_1_MessageCore and Coreto_2_AniMsgTextEffects in that order and enable Text Effects in game options. Select an existing preset with \EFFECT<Name> inside MZ Show Text; presets are configured through ani-message effects list/update (see ANI-DEF-AngleEffects-001 for the shipped Swing preset). Selection affects subsequent letters/icons, including instant text; whitespace advances layout without creating a glyph sprite. <CLEAR EFFECTS> stops assigning effects to subsequent text but already created glyphs keep their assigned effect. A new message page clears/destroys old glyphs and resets selection; window destruction also clears them. Closing hides the sprite container and opening shows it. Other text windows do not animate these tags. No manual sprite creation or cleanup is required for authored messages.
entries.expected: Hello and the icon use Swing sprites; subsequent normal text is static. Existing glyphs retain their effects until page cleanup or window destruction, and their positions track the message window.
